title: HAVENLINE / ASSEMBLY BENCH
detail: Design a substantial compact vehicle-component assembly bench producing either a drive assembly or mobility assembly from steel, mechanical parts, sheet metal and/or planks. Wide low blue-steel bench on timber runners with chunky orange corner guards. One central blue jig holds a SINGLE unfinished dark steel drive-unit housing lengthwise LEFT to RIGHT with an orange clamp crossing it. A strong orange inverted-U gantry above the rear half carries one small centered chain hoist and hook connected to the housing. Machine LEFT end has three broad low feed shelves containing visibly different squat polished blue-silver steel ingots with sloped sides and a recessed rectangular top, a thin dull-gray sheet-metal stack, and a short brown plank bundle. Machine RIGHT end has a heavy open output cradle holding a completed compact dark BLUE ribbed gearbox with a flat ORANGE lid fixed by four silver bolts, silver stub shafts on LEFT and RIGHT ends, and four blue mounting feet, matching the selected DRIVE ASSEMBLY resource (not a full vehicle). FRONT lower shelf has three little parts bins, orange tool drawers and one large orange crank controlling jig; REAR is a plain blue braced panel below bench with exactly two gantry support feet. Fixed items all rotate with the bench. Four broad sturdy metal feet below platform. Manual/mechanical assembly, no glowing sci-fi screen, powered robot arms, fire, smokestack, consumer tire added from nowhere, separate unrelated workshop buildings or currency. Snow only on outside cold platform corners, not tools, rails, gantry chain or workpieces. Preserve the single hoist, jig and output cradle coherently through all angles.

title: HAVENLINE / OIL PUMP
detail: Design an OUTSIDE-CAMP manually operated oil extraction station with a compact blue-and-orange counterweighted walking-beam pump. One thick orange horizontal walking beam on a blue A-frame, rounded blue horsehead at the beam's FRONT end and visible vertical polished rod down to a front wellhead anchored in rock. One orange counterweight crank/flywheel at REAR RIGHT with a stout horizontal hand handle at reachable human height; connected simple linkage moves the beam. No engine, no fuel tank needed to start, no electricity cable. Foundation: short chunky stone-and-steel sled on snowy exposed rock, no painted ground/path. LEFT side has a capped blue buffer drum fastened to frame, with one fixed metal pipe visibly joining wellhead outlet to drum. At FRONT LEFT of drum is one reachable orange-valve filling spout over a small square dock with one short sealed cylindrical DARK GUNMETAL crude-oil barrel with one broad AMBER band around its middle, a cream square badge with a black drop on front and rear, two dark raised metal hoops, and one small offset silver cap on its lid; this is the selected CRUDE OIL resource, absolutely NOT a jerrycan. Keep the spout/drum assembly separate from moving crank. REAR shows actual drive linkage and plain blue frame braces, not another wellhead. Oil stays inside sealed pipework; no oil pools, drilling chemicals, flame or industrial smoke. Winter cold equipment has small snow caps only on stable ledges and frame base; not on pivot/rod or hand crank. Show same beam angle and all landmark positions in every view. Friendly rounded robust game-scale machine, not huge photoreal oilfield machinery.

title: HAVENLINE / FUEL REFINERY
detail: Design a compact COAL-HEATED crude-oil refinery with a distinct twin-vessel silhouette: one tall rounded dark-blue main vessel on the machine LEFT, one shorter blue condenser vessel on the RIGHT, permanently linked by a thick silver upper pipe. Main vessel has two orange retaining bands, a round front thermometer, and rests over a squat gray refractory coal heater; its FRONT low face has one separate orange coal-firebox door and a small coal loading tray. LEFT outer edge has an isolated crude-oil docking inlet: a short sealed cylindrical DARK GUNMETAL crude barrel with a broad AMBER middle band, a cream square badge with a black oil drop on both opposite broad faces, two raised dark hoops and one offset silver cap; a sealed hose fitting at the cap visibly connects by a short pipe to main tank. RIGHT outer edge has a reachable orange fuel-dispensing tap connected to condenser via sealed pipe, over a tray carrying one bright ORANGE rectangular refined-fuel jerrycan with a molded upper handle, raised X on its front/back panels, gray metal bottom rim, silver offset cap and small cream black-drop badge matching the selected FUEL resource. Rear faces: plain bolted insulated blue vessel panels, short gray exhaust chimney rising behind heater, service valve low at rear right. Fixed exact layout is crude IN left, coal below front, refined fuel OUT right; never merge oil/coal inputs or place fuel in furnace. No electric cables, motor, oil slicks, open flame near liquids, wooden supports touching heater, snow on hot vessels or hot piping. Tiny snow on cold exterior stone foundation corners only. Broad sturdy snowy stone plinth and blue steel feet. Keep both vessel sizes, bridge pipe, inlet and outlet fixed coherently in all 8 rotated views. Gameplay abstraction, clean premium chunky industrial design.
